subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank

The loud thunder ______ the children, making them cry.
solution:
The correct answer is '**frightened**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**frightened**" means scared or afraid. (डरना)
 
• The loud thunder would logically cause fear in children, making them cry.
 
• The other options: "**fastened**," "**fainted**," and "**fancied**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The loud thunder frightened__ the children, making them cry.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Fastened (बांधना)**: means to secure or fix firmly in place.
 
• **Fainted (बेहोश होना)**: means to lose consciousness for a short time.
 
• **Fancied (सोचा)**: means to imagine or think.
